title: Core Awakening
tagline: Rebuild yourself from the wreckage of fallen Titans.
pitch: As the last remnant of a Titan AI, you navigate a hostile salvage arena, dodging attacks and dismantling enemies to reclaim your identity. Choose wisely how to salvage components to enhance your mech's capabilities while facing the challenges of tactical combat.
coreLoop: Read the enemy's attack intent, evade or interrupt their move, target their subsystems, and decide how to salvage the defeated foe for your benefit.

mechanics.name: Read & Evade
mechanics.description: Observe enemy telegraphed attacks to either evade or interrupt them, maintaining your core's integrity.

mechanics.name: Target Subsystems
mechanics.description: Aim at distinct subsystems of the enemy that can be disabled for tactical advantages or salvaged for components.

mechanics.name: Three-Way Salvage Decision
mechanics.description: After defeating an enemy, promptly choose to INSTALL, SECURE, or DISMANTLE the acquired component, impacting your mech's capabilities.

controls.keyboard: WASD for movement, mouse for aiming and targeting
controls.mouse: Click to attack or interact with components

artDirection.backgroundFx: abstract machinery silhouettes slowly moving in the background

difficulty.start: minimal enemy attacks with clear telegraphs to understand gameplay
difficulty.progression: attacks become more complex while providing clear signals, pushing the player to adapt
difficulty.peak: a balanced challenge where every decision directly affects the fight's outcome, keeping tension high

winLose.win: secure a component from the defeated enemy and successfully extract it
winLose.lose: the core mech is destroyed losing the run

juice.screenShake: when an enemy is defeated or a subsystem is disabled
juice.particles: when components are salvaged or damaged
juice.hitStop: when the player successfully interrupts an enemy attack
juice.flash: when making the three-way decision after defeating an enemy

scopeNotes: Do not include procedural dungeons, an economy/shop, multiple enemy types, bosses, inventory management, crafting, upgrades between runs, and narrative scenes beyond one line of flavor text.

scoreEvents: score increases when an enemy is defeated, when a subsystem is targeted and damaged, and when selecting salvage options
